title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer - smoothing window, backoff ordering, and regional failover guard
author: Ava Martinez
release_notes: Stability hotfix: smooth SLO enforcer state transitions, introduce exponential backoff ordering and regional-failover guard to reduce cascading load-shedding and thrashing. No API change.
description:
Context: During a production incident on 2025-11-11 we observed the SLO enforcer rapidly oscillating between healthy/unhealthy states across regions which caused cascading load-shedding and unnecessary regional failovers. Root cause: aggressive instantaneous thresholding combined with out-of-order backoff updates when multiple controllers concurrently evaluated the same circuit. This PR stabilizes the enforcer with three coordinated changes: 1) add an adaptive smoothing window (EWMA-based) for SLI inputs to avoid reacting to short spikes; 2) change backoff state updates to use ordered compare-and-swap with monotonic backoff escalation to prevent back-to-healthy races; 3) add a regional failover guard that requires sustained cross-region failures for 30s before triggering failover. The patch also adds tests, metrics, and a short migration note. Checklist:
- [x] Implement EWMA smoothing on request latency and error-rate SLIs
- [x] Ensure backoff updates are ordered (CAS) and introduce monotonic escalation + capped decay
- [x] Add regional failover guard (sustained window) and config flag to opt-in for tenants during rollout
- [x] Unit tests for ordering and smoothing
- [x] E2E canary test in perf-canary and controlled rollout plan
- [x] Add observability counters and dashboards for backoff events
- [x] Update incident runbook and docs

Motivation: Reduce cascade and thrashing while preserving fast failure for genuine outages. Rollout plan: merge to main -> deploy canary in us-west2 with 5% traffic -> monitor onboarding metrics (slo_enforcer.backoff_events, slo_enforcer.smoothing_delta, regional_failover.triggers) -> 24h observation -> global rollout. Related: ENG-2217 / ENG-2239. No user-facing API changes. Testing: unit + integration tests included; perf-canary passed in internal staging during validation. See changed files for implementation notes.

diff_snippets: serving/slo/enforcer.go: + EWMA smoothing applied to observed latency/error rates (alpha configurable, default 0.2)
